# Fix Demo Notebook Issues (Part 2)

## Summary
Verified and fixed issues in the last two cells of `demo.ipynb` related to the Photonic Integrated Circuit demo.

## Methodology
1. Extracted the code from the problematic cells into temporary scripts (`reproduce_cell_5.py`, `reproduce_cell_6.py`).
2. Confirmed `TypeError` in Cell 5 due to float assignment to complex field.
3. Confirmed `NameError` in Cell 6 due to missing variable definitions (broken duplicate).
4. Validated the fix for Cell 5 by running the corrected script.
